title: Alexander Hamilton
lyrics:
[00:03.42] How does a bastard, orphan, son of a whore
[00:07.28] And a Scotsman, dropped in the middle of a forgotten
[00:11.25] Spot in the Caribbean by providence, impoverished, in squalor
[00:15.82] Grow up to be a hero and a scholar?
[00:18.71] The ten-dollar Founding Father without a father
[00:22.22] Got a lot farther by working a lot harder
[00:25.69] By being a lot smarter, by being a self-starter
[00:29.27] By 14, they placed him in charge of a trading charter

[02:03.83] There would have been nothin' left to do
[02:05.73] For someone less astute
[02:07.18] He woulda been dead or destitute
[02:08.65] Without a cent of restitution
[02:10.66] Started workin', clerkin' for his late mother's landlord

[02:17.92] Scammin' for every book he can get his hands on
[02:21.41] Plannin' for the future, see him now as he stands on
[02:25.01] The bow of a ship headed for a new land
[02:28.34] In New York, you can be a new man
[02:32.06] (In New York, you can be a new man) Just you wait!
[02:35.52] (In New York, you can be a new man) Just you wait!
[02:39.12] In New York, you can be a new man
[02:42.53] In New York! (New York)
[02:44.61] Just you wait!
[02:46.37] Alexander Hamilton (Alexander Hamilton)
[02:49.42] We are waiting in the wings for you (waiting in the wings for you)
[02:53.13] You could never back down
[02:55.13] You never learned to take your time!
[02:59.58] Oh, Alexander Hamilton (Alexander Hamilton)
[03:03.65] When America sings for you
[03:06.89] Will they know what you overcame?
[03:10.34] Will they know you rewrote the game?
[03:13.89] The world will never be the same, oh

[03:23.38] See if you can spot him (just you wait)
[03:25.48] Another immigrant

[03:28.73] His enemies destroyed his rep
[03:30.47] America forgot him
[03:32.16] We fought with him
[03:34.16] Me? I died for him
[03:35.91] Me? I trusted him
[03:37.64] Me? I loved him
[03:39.12] And me? I'm the damn fool that shot him
[03:43.47] There's a million things I haven't done
[03:46.31] But just you wait!
[03:49.55] What's your name, man?
[03:51.08] Alexander Hamilton!
